title: Integrate context-collapse and snipping parity where supported
objective: Decide and implement the Go equivalent for TS context-collapse and history snip ordering, or explicitly document unsupported behavior.
implementation_scope: Map which TS context-collapse capabilities have Go equivalents.
Ensure any history snip projection runs before microcompact/autocompact in the correct order if kept.
If context-collapse exists in Go, project collapsed view before auto-compact and drain staged collapses before reactive compact.
If context-collapse is not supported, remove misleading parity docs and ensure HistorySnip is labeled as fallback, not equivalent.
Thread snipTokensFreed or equivalent into auto-compact threshold checks if snip survives.
out_of_scope: Do not implement a full context-collapse subsystem from scratch unless explicitly approved later.
Do not block P0 reactive compact on context-collapse parity.
acceptance_criteria: The Go pipeline order for snip/collapse/microcompact/autocompact is explicit and tested.
If collapse is unsupported, code and docs do not claim parity.
Reactive overflow recovery uses collapse drain first only when a real collapse subsystem exists.
risks: Context-collapse is feature-flagged and may be absent from open builds; avoid importing unavailable TS-only assumptions.
Snip token accounting can falsely trigger or suppress auto-compact if not plumbed carefully.
dispatch_prompt: Audit and align Go's snip/context-collapse position relative to TS, implementing supported equivalents and clearly documenting unsupported context-collapse behavior.
